dispute_ticket.description: My mother and I took a ride from Bedok Mall to Tan Tock Seng Hospital for her appointment. The app said $13.50 but I was charged $17.20 because the driver missed the KPE exit and went a long way round, and we almost missed her slot. He did help my mother out of the car by the arm at the hospital entrance and was very patient with her, but please refund the extra $3.70.

rider_route_requests_must_be_agreed_befo.text: Binds the rider. A route or stop that the rider asks for must be agreed with the driver before the trip starts. It does not govern route changes the driver makes.
